baseline._about: What the learner already knows: an Android engineer who finished the Kotlin Multiplatform course here (its Compose puzzles 13-15 are linked under "from") and writes Jetpack Compose at work: Text, Column, Row, Button, Modifier, remember, mutableStateOf. They have never looked inside Compose and have never shipped Compose Multiplatform to iOS.

Composer.def: The runtime's recorder: the compiler plugin passes it into every composable call, and the call records what it did through it.

$changed.def: A hidden Int the caller fills with what it already knows about each argument, such as "same as last time".

startRestartGroup.def: The Composer call the plugin puts at the start of a composable's body: it opens the call's group.

endRestartGroup.def: The Composer call the plugin puts at the end of a composable's body: it closes the call's group.

group.def: Everything one composable call records between its start and its end, labelled with a key: from the function's name and parameters for a function's own group, from its position for groups inside a body.

composition.def: The tree of groups your composables recorded on their first run, with their nodes and slots, kept and updated between runs.

node.def: A real UI element that a composable such as Text leaves in the composition; in Compose UI it's a LayoutNode.

LayoutNode.def: Compose UI's node class: one element of the UI tree, with a size, a position and a way to draw itself.

slot.def: A cell where a group keeps a value: an argument it got last time, or something it asked to remember.

slot table.def: The runtime's storage for the composition: every group and its slots, in the order the calls ran.

call site.def: The place in your source where a composable is called; calls from one call site, such as a loop, are told apart only by their order.

key().def: A composable that wraps calls in a movable group whose identity comes from a value you pass, such as an item's id, so the group moves with its item.

snapshot state.def: A value holder made by mutableStateOf; Compose watches every read and every write of its value.

state read.def: Code reading a snapshot state's value while Compose runs it; Compose notes which group was running.

restart group.def: The group of a composable that Compose can run again on its own, from its start; Android's docs call it a restart scope.

Recomposer.def: The part of the runtime that decides when marked groups run: it waits for the next frame, then runs every marked restart group again.

skipping.def: A call not running its body, and keeping last time's record, because its arguments equal the ones it got last time.

stable.def: A type that can't change without Compose seeing it: it never changes, or changes only through snapshot state. Compared with equals.

unstable.def: A type that could change without Compose seeing it, such as a class with a var or a List.

strong skipping.def: The compiler mode, on by default since Kotlin 2.0.20, that lets a call with unstable arguments be skipped when the same instances (===) come back.

@Stable.def: An annotation that promises Compose a type is stable when it can't prove it.

phase.def: One of the three stages Compose runs to make a frame, in order: composition, layout, drawing.

constraints.def: The smallest and largest width and height a parent allows a child.

measure.def: Ask a child to choose its size within the constraints; in Compose, each child is measured at most once per layout.

placement.def: A parent setting each measured child's x, y position, relative to itself.

canvas.def: The drawing surface a node draws itself onto, with commands like drawRect; Compose's Canvas is an interface.

drawRect.def: A canvas command that fills a rectangle with a colour.

Applier.def: The plug between the runtime and a tree: it inserts, moves and removes nodes; the runtime knows nodes only through it.

Compose UI.def: The layer that turns nodes into a screen: LayoutNode, Modifier, input, layout and drawing.

foundation.def: The layer of building blocks with no look of their own: Row, Column, LazyColumn, gestures.

design system.def: A set of rules and ready-made components for how an app looks: colours, type, shapes. Material Design is Google's.

hosting boundary.def: The region where one UI system embeds another.

accessibility semantics.def: Labels, roles, states and actions exposed to assistive technology.

skipToGroupEnd().def: The Composer call a skipped composable makes: jump past its group and keep what it recorded last time.

UiApplier.def: Compose UI's Applier on Android: it inserts, moves and removes LayoutNodes.

deferring a read.def: Moving a state read out of a parent and into the child, or the later phase, that needs the value, so less code runs again when it changes.

drawBehind.def: A modifier whose lambda runs during drawing, so a state read inside it reruns drawing alone.

org.jetbrains.kotlin.plugin.compose.def: The id of the Gradle plugin that turns the Compose compiler plugin on in a build.

@Immutable.def: An annotation that promises Compose a type never changes once an instance is made.

skikoMain.def: The source set shared by every Compose target that draws with Skia through Skiko: iOS, desktop and web.

iosMain.def: The source set for code that only iOS builds compile.

androidMain.def: The source set for code that only Android builds compile.

nativeMain.def: The source set shared by every Kotlin/Native target.

darwinMain.def: The source set shared by every Apple target.

DefaultUiApplier.def: Compose UI's Applier on iOS, desktop and web, in skikoMain: it inserts, moves and removes LayoutNodes.

UIViewController.def: UIKit's base class for a controller that manages one screen's views.

UINavigationController.def: UIKit's controller for a stack of screens, with a title bar, a back button and the back swipe.

MainViewController.def: Our Kotlin function in iosMain that returns ComposeUIViewController { BookmarksScreen() } for Swift to use.

Main_iosKt.def: The name Swift sees for the top-level functions of the Kotlin file main.ios.kt.

UIViewControllerRepresentable.def: A SwiftUI protocol that wraps a UIKit view controller so SwiftUI can show it.

makeUIViewController.def: The method of a UIViewControllerRepresentable that creates the wrapped controller.

factory.def: UIKitView's parameter that creates the native view, once, when the call enters the composition.

onRelease.def: UIKitView's parameter that runs when the native view leaves the composition for good, to clean up.

onReset.def: UIKitView's parameter that, when set, lets Compose reuse the same native view instead of creating a new one.

addTarget.def: UIKit's call that tells a control to call a method by name when an event happens.

UIControlEventEditingChanged.def: The UIKit event a text field sends whenever its text changes.

@ObjCAction.def: A Kotlin/Native annotation that makes a Kotlin function callable as an Objective-C action method.

editingChanged.def: Our Kotlin method on the text field, called by UIKit on every edit.

pointerInput.def: A modifier that hands raw touch events to your code; it adds no semantics.

detectTapGestures.def: A helper inside pointerInput that calls you back on a tap.

Modifier.toggleable.def: A foundation modifier that makes an element on or off, reacts to taps and accessibility actions, and adds the matching semantics.

Role.Switch.def: The semantics role that tells accessibility services an element is a switch.

IconToggleButton.def: Material's on/off icon button; it is toggleable with a checkbox role and merges its children's semantics.

onValueChange.def: toggleable's callback: asked to flip the value, after a tap or an accessibility action.

avoid._about: Words a beginner misreads or that hide who does what. The lint fails on them; name the actor or say the plain word instead.

phrases.the system: name the actor: the runtime, the compiler plugin, the Recomposer
phrases.simply: cut it: it makes a learner who's stuck feel slow
phrases.just a: cut it, or say what it is
phrases.magic: say what does it: the compiler plugin, the runtime
